en.title: P.A.V.E
en.decryption: Remember these four pillars of the Gupta cultural revival: Compiling Puranas, Classical Art, Vaishnava patronage, and finalizing the Mahabharata/Ramayana.

fact.en: Mistaking Gupta tolerance for lack of patronage; while tolerant, the state was distinctly Brahmanical.

fact.en: Assuming Buddhism declined entirely; it thrived in universities like Nalanda during this period.
